query:
SELECT 
  sr.id,
  sr.sessionSummary,
  sr.createdByUserId,
  u.name as therapist_name,
  p.name as patient_name
FROM sessionRecords sr
LEFT JOIN users u ON sr.createdByUserId = u.id
LEFT JOIN patients p ON sr.patientId = p.id
LIMIT 5;
